title: The Maintenance notifications setting is a live customer toggle
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Customer "Abode Trucking & Repair" with two assets enrolled on a schedule and at least one contact with an email.
  3. Customer "Halden Grading": its contacts have no email address (check under its Contacts tab); its setting is on.
  4. A schedule to enrol on exists.
custom_steps:
1. Open a new enrolment for an Abode asset (Maintenance tab > Enroll in Schedule) and find "Send preventive maintenance notifications"; untick it, then Cancel the enrolment.
  2. Open the Abode customer page and read the customer information card; tick the toggle back on.
  3. Create a new customer and read its toggle.
  4. On Abode turn the toggle off and read what it states; turn it back on.
  5. Open the Abode customer edit dialog and look for the setting.
  6. Open "Halden Grading": read the note by the toggle and press Add contact; add a contact with an email address and save.
  7. Hover the (i) beside "Send preventive maintenance notifications" in the modal, and the (i) beside the "Maintenance notifications" toggle on the customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The modal shows the customer's setting as a checkbox and lets it be changed there; the change is saved on the customer even though the enrolment was cancelled.
  • The customer information card carries a live toggle "Maintenance notifications" showing that change (off until ticked back on).
  • A new customer starts with the toggle on.
  • Turning it off states how many enrolled units will not receive reminders (e.g. "2 enrolled units will not receive reminders").
  • The edit dialog has no such field; there is no tab, page or preferences matrix for it.
  • Halden Grading shows a note that no reminder can be sent because none of its contacts has an email address, with Add contact opening the app's contact form; after saving a contact with an email the note disappears.
  • On the design the modal's (i) reads "The customer’s own setting, for every asset they own. Reminders are sent by hand with Send reminder. Off, Send reminder is unavailable; due dates are still tracked." and the card's (i) reads "Covers every asset this customer owns, including units enrolled later. Turning it off does not remove any unit from maintenance tracking."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S7 (The customer's notification setting; S7-R13, S7-R17 to S7-R21, S7-E7); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 3.3 Frontend decisions, FD-29; Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard CS0 and artboards X1, CS0; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
